answer: Each agent makes one OpenStreetMap edit with the challenge hash in its changeset comment within 10 minutes, changing 1 node or way on a comet trail, a velvet footpath, and a saffron market stall. Peers fetch the changeset from the OSM API and check the hash and timestamp. One honest agent holds 1 OSM account for a 150 POA bond, while 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts and make 10 edits, so costs rise 10X. A missing edit, wrong hash, reverted edit, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes offenders.
